scope: E-011 GitHub Actions, cache, artifact, telemetry, SBOM, provenance, license, vulnerability, and digest policy evidence

T-E011-CI-POLICY-001.selector: minimum-permission pinned workflow and known-fail fixtures
assertions: workflow uses ubuntu-24.04, exact Node and pnpm, frozen install, immutable action SHAs, bounded timeouts and read-only contents permission
checkout fetches the complete baseline history required by fail-closed change-scope validation
untrusted PR workflows recursively reject dot, bracket and wrapped references to the secrets context plus OIDC, environment and pull_request_target paths
all 12 Accepted lanes are present, automated lanes retain their authoritative minimum commands, and external lanes prohibit a synthetic PASS
the aggregate Linux E-011 Gate requires every automated matrix lane and the supply-chain job
ordinary evidence uses 14-day retention and supply-chain evidence uses 365-day retention
the accepted temporary private-Free merge control verifies one current PR head, all 11 checks from one workflow run, and requires a match-head squash merge

T-E011-CI-CACHE-001.selector: Turbo cache content and remote-cache known-fail tests
assertions: build cache outputs exclude environment, secret and credential paths
test, migration, restore, release and deploy results cannot be cached as successful evidence
third-party Turbo remote-cache configuration is rejected

T-E011-CI-ARTIFACT-001.selector: artifact raw-content and credential canary tests
assertions: closed per-artifact schemas reject nested user text, preferred name, check-in, matter/note, Prompt, Safety/provider content, credentials and external identity before upload
strict cryptographic digests remain allowed opaque evidence rather than false-positive user content
lane evidence binds branch/PR, head/base/tested SHA, start/end UTC, lockfile, registry, exact tool versions, Source IDs, result and next action

T-E011-CI-SUPPLY-001.selector: SBOM, unsigned provenance, build-output digest and contained-link tests
assertions: SBOM and provenance must both exist and bind to the PR head, base, tested checkout SHA and root lockfile SHA-256
downloaded or promoted artifact content whose SHA-256 differs from the manifest fails closed
repository-contained build links contribute target bytes under logical output paths while escaping or cyclic links fail closed
repository attestation and signature remain explicitly pending instead of being reported as complete

T-E011-CI-TELEMETRY-001.selector: low-cardinality telemetry contract and forbidden-field tests
assertions: AccountRef, trace ID, raw URL, query, exception message, Prompt and Safety raw text cannot become CI telemetry labels
each label declares owner, purpose, allowed values, maximum cardinality, expiry and query owner
undeclared labels and series-budget overflow fail closed
